next_steps.action: Measure the VRM input voltage at the high-side FET drains (typically +VCC_CORE_IN, often derived from adapter/battery through a small buck or directly).

measure.where: High-side FET drain pads (all phases share the same VIN)
measure.expected: Typically the adapter/battery rail (19 V / 12.6 V) or a dedicated +VCC_CORE_IN buck (typically 5-12 V).
measure.safety: High-side FET drain is at adapter potential; probe with care.

interpretations.then: Input supply good. Proceed to check controller VCC.
Upstream +VCC_CORE_IN buck or input path is dead. Diagnose that rail first.

next_steps.requires_info_note: Need board schematic or controller datasheet to know the expected VRM input voltage.
